known-gaps.description: pyflakes needs Python, which this toolchain does not require of the host, so run: scripts with shell: python are not linted for Python errors.
The ShellCheck family accepts any code from SC1000 to SC3999, including one ShellCheck never emits, because the set of codes is generated from the pinned source by the currency phase (phase 8).
A step whose runs-on: is an expression that resolves to a Windows runner is checked as bash, so a PowerShell script there can draw false ShellCheck findings; give the step an explicit shell: pwsh.

actionlint checks workflow files only, so composite actions (action.yml) and the Dependabot file are discovered and named on standard error as unanalysed, but analysed by no lane until the zizmor backend (phase 4) and the coverage check (phase 6) arrive.

`check` runs the actionlint lane in a child process with a time limit, so a workflow that crashes its parser or never finishes is exit 4; but the `rule` harness still runs actionlint inside its own process, so a workflow built to recurse without bound (a million nested parentheses) ends `rule` with the Go runtime's own exit code 2, and one built to be slow runs there without a time bound.

A workflow file holding a second YAML document is analysed on its first document only, and the second is not read; whether GitHub accepts such a file is not confirmed, so it stays a gap until the lint-coverage check (phase 6) decides it.
That actions-qa-ci is the Detector and zizmor and actionlint are bundled rule backends is a reading of toolchain 4.1 the specification does not spell out; it stands until the Owner confirms it.
